meta.name: Unconditional
meta.description: A mother-daughter vacation abroad takes a devastating turn when Gali is arrested for drug possession. Refusing to accept the charges, her mother Orna risks everything on a quest for freedom—only to get entangled in a web of Gali's secrets.

videos.title: Lucky Kid
videos.overview: A vacation comes to an abrupt end when Gali is arrested at a Moscow airport, plunging her mother Orna into an unthinkable nightmare.

videos.title: Everyone's Daughter
videos.overview: Orna follows the trail of Gali's mysterious passports and comes under pressure to abandon a crucial televised interview.

videos.title: The West Side
videos.overview: As negotiations with Russia stall, Orna and Dori try tracking down an ex–special ops mercenary with ties to Gali.

videos.title: Everybody's Sorry
videos.overview: News of a potential prisoner exchange changes everything for Orna. Benny's health begins to deteriorate.

videos.title: Yuri Glaskov
videos.overview: Orna and her new ally Rita travel to Moscow hoping to force Gali's release—only to uncover a darker truth.

videos.title: Smile Already
videos.overview: Gali tries to broker a business deal with a dangerous man ahead of her mother-daughter trip.

videos.title: Back-Seat People
videos.overview: After returning to India to seek an asset that could set Gali free, Orna discovers the depths of her daughter's entanglement.

videos.title: The Seed
videos.overview: Orna does everything in her power to bring Gali home.
